dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-gradient transitions from bright white perimeters to dark centers. The geometry ranges from near-perfect circular rings in the mid-lateral region to more irregular, elongated elliptical boundaries along the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid high-intensity pixel clusters are sparse, with most brightness concentrated in the thin perimeters of the annuli. A small collection of isolated, high-intensity white speckles lacking internal gradients is visible in the anterior region near the head.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest mid-dorsal annuli form a non-uniform quadrilateral. A secondary grouping of three distinct annuli in the posterior-lateral region forms an approximate scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme posterior body tapering resulting in a sharp terminal point; distinct light-intensity muzzle area contrasted against a dark-intensity head.
